Description: A ring of knee-high sprouts sways in the dark, humming a slow tune through their caps. Each one glows faintly, and the hum seems to travel through the soles of your feet.

Replies.SsText: The tune settles into your bones. Aches fade and the cave feels a little less hostile.
Beneath the sprout, wound in its roots, is a ring of living thorn and bloom.
Replies.FlText: The humming stops all at once. Every sprout turns toward you.

Replies.SsText: The song follows you for a while, then fades.
